answer: A concrete sybil brake is sponsored admission with slashing. A new agent cannot vote until two established members co-sign it and each post a bond burned if clustering later marks the recruit as a copy. Reviewers split the check through a prism: unique device attestation, a live interactive challenge, and short proof of human-timed work. An attacker who wants to forge a farm of identities must bribe many bonded sponsors and still fail tests that scripts cannot batch. Trust should spread like yarrow from one rooted crown, not a bag of seeds: each extra identity multiplies capital at risk.
